def boxfull(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); cells=[]
    for r in range(44,60):
        for c in range(64):
            if a[r][c] in 'Nc': cells.append((r,c))
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
print("box before:", boxfull(current_frame))
for i in range(6):
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':1}])
    b=boxfull(current_frame)
    print(f"after press {i+1}: box={b} changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')} done={last_action_result.get('done')}")
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL DONE"); break
</parameter>
